steps.data: <?php /* Sample content import: only make thumbnails, which halves the import time. The last step removes this file. */ add_filter( 'intermediate_image_sizes_advanced', function ( $sizes ) { return array_intersect_key( $sizes, array( 'thumbnail' => true ) ); } );
